title: Churn-Risk Outreach Automation
summary: Spot customers showing churn signals, explain why for each one, and run consented retention outreach on WhatsApp, SMS, voice or a human call with offers from your eligibility rules.

seo.title: Churn-Risk Scoring and Retention Outreach | VipraTech
seo.description: Churn-risk scoring with reasons for telecom and broadband customers, plus consented retention outreach on WhatsApp, SMS, voice and human agents.

problem.intro: By the time a customer requests a porting code or stops recharging, the retention window is short. The signals were often visible earlier, such as repeated call drops or slow speeds at home, an unresolved billing complaint, falling usage, a lapsed recharge or a competitor's offer mentioned on a support call, but they sit in different systems and the retention team works from a generic list.

pain_points.title: Signals sit in silos
pain_points.detail: Network KPIs, complaints, usage, recharge history and call transcripts are owned by different teams and rarely combined.

pain_points.title: Generic offers
pain_points.detail: The same discount goes to everyone, including customers who would have stayed anyway, while unhappy customers get an offer instead of a fix.

pain_points.title: Scores without reasons
pain_points.detail: A risk score alone does not tell the retention agent what went wrong or how to open the conversation.

pain_points.title: Consent and contact fatigue
pain_points.detail: Repeated outreach across campaigns annoys customers and risks breaching preference and consent rules.

solution.overview: We build a churn-risk and outreach workflow on top of your existing data. A scoring model combines usage trends, recharge and payment behaviour, network experience at the customer's usual locations, complaint history and signals extracted from support transcripts, and explains each score with its top reasons. Rules then decide the action: fix first for customers with an open network or billing issue, an offer from your eligibility engine for value at risk, or no contact for those likely to stay. Outreach goes through the customer's consented channel, whether WhatsApp, SMS, a voice agent or a human retention agent with a briefing card, after suppression and frequency checks. Holdout groups show whether outreach helped.
capabilities: Churn-risk scoring from usage, recharge, payment, network experience and complaint data, with reasons per customer
Signals extracted from support call transcripts, chats and emails, such as competitor mentions
Next-best-action rules: fix the open issue, offer from the eligibility engine, or do not contact
Outreach across WhatsApp, SMS, voice agent and human retention agents with briefing cards
Consent, DND preference, suppression and contact-frequency checks before every message
Holdout groups and campaign reporting to measure the effect of outreach

workflow.title: Build features
workflow.detail: Usage, recharge, payment, network, complaint and transcript signals are combined per customer.

workflow.title: Score risk with reasons
workflow.detail: Each customer gets a churn-risk score and the top reasons behind it.

workflow.title: Choose the next best action
workflow.detail: Rules pick fix-first, an eligible offer or no contact, and assign a holdout group.

workflow.title: Check consent and contact rules
workflow.detail: Consent, DND preference, suppression and frequency caps are checked before any outreach.

workflow.title: Reach out
workflow.detail: High-value customers and those with open complaints go to retention agents; others receive WhatsApp, SMS or voice agent outreach.

workflow.title: Measure and learn
workflow.detail: Outcomes are compared with the holdout group and fed back into the model and rules.

inputs: Network experience KPIs mapped to customer locations
Consent, DND preference and opt-out data
human_in_the_loop: Retention managers approve the action rules, offers and contact caps, and human retention agents handle high-value customers and anyone with an open complaint. Marketing and compliance review every message template before use.
integrations: Data warehouse or CDP such as BigQuery or Snowflake
WhatsApp Business API and SMS gateway with DLT templates
guardrails: No outreach without consent, preference and suppression checks
Offers only from the eligibility engine
Outreach never delays or discourages a porting request
Scores reviewed by segment and circle to catch skew
compliance_notes: Outreach respects TRAI commercial-communication rules, including customer preferences, registered headers and DLT templates for SMS.
Retention activity does not interfere with porting requests, which must be handled as TRAI's mobile number portability rules require.
Customer data use is designed to support DPDP Act 2023 purpose limitation and consent.

pilot.scope: One segment, such as broadband or postpaid customers in one circle, with a holdout group and one or two outreach channels.
deliverables: Churn definition agreed for the pilot segment
Scoring model with reasons, backtested on historical data
Action rules and outreach set-up with consent checks

what_we_measure.how: Backtest of how many actual churners fall in the highest-risk groups on past data.
Churn in the treated group compared with the holdout group over the pilot period.
Messages blocked by pre-send checks, opt-out requests and complaints during the pilot.
Offer spend divided by customers retained relative to the holdout.

faqs.q: What data do we need to start?
faqs.a: Usage and recharge or billing history, complaint and ticket data, and past churn outcomes are the minimum. Network experience by location and transcript signals improve explanations and are added where available.

faqs.q: Does it work for prepaid customers?
faqs.a: Yes. Prepaid churn often shows up as a recharge lapse rather than a formal disconnection, so we define churn with your team for each segment before modelling.

faqs.q: How do you make sure outreach is compliant?
faqs.a: Every message passes consent, DND preference, suppression and frequency checks first, SMS uses registered DLT templates, and outreach never delays or discourages a porting request.

faqs.q: Can retention agents see why a customer was flagged?
faqs.a: Yes. Each customer comes with the top reasons behind the score, such as repeated call drops at home or an unresolved billing complaint, so the agent can open with the fix rather than an offer.
